# Browser upload producer fixture

`script-upload-browser.json` contains two original requests generated by the
production TypeScript upload helpers in `_upload-contracts.ts`. The producer
test preserves each exact serialized JSON request in `request_json`, alongside
the expected immutable manifest and original script bytes.

The first case uses the earlier PHP HTTP catalogue fixture. The second includes
all four input types, UTF-8 supplementary characters, CRLF line endings, zero
retained output, two accepted exit codes and reviewed owned-job termination.
All code and runtime identities are synthetic; nothing is executed.

Original exports B and C under `.endpoint-tools/script-upload-20261020` and this
fixture have SHA-256
`365dfdb982e9b3e41a9512dc2eb389e6aa95c5951a7435df4975d6cda101d599`.
`EndpointScriptBrowserUploadTest` passes the original serialized request through
the real controller body/binary readers and the catalogue's material validator.
This is parser/material interoperability evidence, separate from authenticated
HTTP lifecycle, visual-browser or installed-execution evidence.
